name: Alternate Beta
description: Use alternate beta in the available styles and weights.

name: Alternate Delta
description: Use alternate delta in the available styles and weights.

name: Alternate Hbar
description: Use the original hslash form for hbar.

name: Alternate Conjunction
description: Use alternate small and large conjunction signs.

name: Straight Braces
description: Select straight braces; overrides extended Curly braces.

name: Extended Parentheses
description: Enable the additional large ready-made parentheses.

name: Extended Curly Braces
description: Enable the additional large ready-made Curly braces.

name: Horizontal Brace Forms
description: Select the design of overbraces and underbraces.

name: Proper Inclusion Forms
description: Use alternate proper subset and superset signs.

name: Unequal Comparison Forms
description: Use alternate less-than and greater-than but not equal signs.

name: Negated Comparison Forms
description: Select negated comparisons independently of negated inclusions.

name: Negated Inclusion Forms
description: Select the AMS alternate or double-equality negated inclusions.

name: Smile and Frown Forms
description: Use the smaller smile and frown signs.

name: Yen Form
description: Use the original AMS yen sign.

name: Registered Form
description: Use the original AMS registered sign.
